text:
Tess: opened a migration PR to update audit-export docs for SDK v2 + SOC2-safe wording. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1301
Omar: thanks. are we renaming any params in examples? iirc time_window landed last sprint.
Tess: yes — examples use time_window now. i added a short curl and python snippet for the export CLI/SDK.
Tess: curl:
```bash
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"tenant_id":"acme-42","pseudonymize":true,"time_window":{"from":"2025-06-01","to":"2025-06-30"}}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/audit/export
```
Tess: python:
```py
from redwood import AuditClient
client = AuditClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.export_evidence(tenant_id='acme-42', pseudonymize=True, time_window=('2025-06-01','2025-06-30'))
```
Tess: in the sample output i replaced user_id/email with pseudonymized_user_id / pseudonymized_email and kept event_timestamp and resource fields. added a mapping table for downstreams.
legal-ops: quick read — prefer explicit phrasing: "Identifiers in exports are pseudonymized (irreversible hashing). Timestamps and audit metadata are retained for evidentiary purposes." Also request we use "tenant (customer-owned namespace)" once where ambiguity may arise.
Omar: noted. i'll update the SDK docs to show the exact exported field names (pseudonymized_user_id, pseudonymized_email, session_id hashed) so integrators can map them.
devex-bot: Docs PR checklist: add CODEOWNERS, include a snippet unit test, run link-checker, update changelog.
Tess: will make the wording swap, add CODEOWNERS, and include a tiny json-structure test. will ping for a final pass. :thumbsup:
